thesis: The episode explores the history of ketchup, noting its origins as a Chinese fermented fish sauce that was adapted by Europeans and Americans to include tomatoes and other ingredients. It highlights Heinz's early 1900s innovation of removing synthetic preservatives like sodium benzoate in favor of vinegar and glass bottles to demonstrate purity, an ethos that aligns with the modern brand Sir Kensington's.
